name: Multimodal Visual Patterns (MMVP)
description: MMVP is a benchmark designed to expose visual shortcomings in multimodal large language models by focusing on nine basic visual patterns. It evaluates the ability of models like GPT-4V to correctly interpret images that are challenging for CLIP-based visual embeddings, highlighting errors and hallucinated explanations.
reputation: A widely cited multimodal diagnostic benchmark for exposing visual reasoning failures in MLLMs.
notes: Focuses on visual embedding limitations of CLIP in multimodal LLMs; introduces 'CLIP-blind pairs' to reveal model weaknesses.
